rca_of_issue: Root cause was that the post-onboarding branch in tina_service.py treated chip payloads with empty `message` as 'no user input' and fell through to scripted onboarding/360 quiz branches. Fix coerces ALL three chip variants (selected_360_option dict → label/option_key; selected_option str → str; selected_options list → comma-join) into user_message BEFORE the empty-message gate, AND the stale-p360 quiz dispatch (inactive/active branches) is deleted, so actually_complete users can NEVER be routed into scripted Q&A. Verified by 9/9 iter26 tests + 4/4 iter28 chip-variant tests + 33/33 regression.
